exams.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Associate
exams.blurb: Validates designing OCI infrastructure including compute, networking, storage, databases and identity for resilient cloud solutions.

exams.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Associate
exams.blurb: Introductory credential covering OCI core services, networking, storage, compute, pricing and security for cloud practitioners.

exams.name: Oracle Database Administration Certified Professional
exams.blurb: Validates administration of Oracle Database including multitenant, backup, recovery, performance and instance configuration tasks.

exams.name: Associate Certified Analytics Professional
exams.blurb: Entry-level INFORMS analytics credential for candidates with a degree but limited experience, covering the same analytics process domains as CAP.

exams.name: Certified Analytics Professional
exams.blurb: Vendor-neutral INFORMS credential covering the end-to-end analytics process from business problem framing through modelling to deployment and lifecycle.

exams.name: Cloudera CDP Generalist Certification
exams.blurb: Cloudera exam covering the Cloudera Data Platform across public and private cloud, including data hub, warehouse, machine learning and governance.

exams.name: Cloudera Certified Professional Data Engineer
exams.blurb: Retired hands-on Cloudera exam requiring candidates to ingest, transform and analyse data on a live Hadoop cluster; still widely referenced by employers.

exams.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
exams.blurb: Multi-course online programme covering machine learning, deep learning with Keras and PyTorch, computer vision and deploying models to production.

exams.name: IBM Data Science Professional Certificate
exams.blurb: Multi-course online programme covering Python, SQL, data analysis, visualisation and machine learning with hands-on capstone projects.

exams.name: Neo4j Certified Professional
exams.blurb: Free Neo4j certification covering property graph modelling, the Cypher query language, indexes, constraints and Neo4j database administration.

exams.name: Neo4j Graph Data Science Certification
exams.blurb: Neo4j certification covering graph algorithms, graph projections, centrality and community detection and machine learning pipelines on graphs.

exams.name: Epic Ambulatory Analyst Certification
exams.blurb: Healthcare IT credential for configuring Epic Ambulatory outpatient EHR workflows, scheduling and clinical documentation.

exams.name: Epic Beaker Analyst Certification
exams.blurb: Role-based lab information system credential earned through Epic employment covering Beaker build, orders and results workflow.

exams.name: HubSpot Inbound Certification
exams.blurb: Free foundational credential covering inbound methodology, content, social, SEO and nurturing for marketing and sales professionals.

exams.name: HubSpot Marketing Software Certification
exams.blurb: Validates using HubSpot Marketing Hub for email, automation, forms, landing pages and analytics in inbound campaigns.

exams.name: Workday Pro Certification - HCM
exams.blurb: Role-based credential for implementing and configuring Workday Human Capital Management, earned through partner or customer programs.

exams.name: Workday Pro Certification - Integrations
exams.blurb: Validates building Workday integrations using EIB, Workday Studio and web services for enterprise HR and finance data flows.

exams.name: Astronomer Certification: Apache Airflow Fundamentals
exams.blurb: Certification on Apache Airflow covering DAG authoring, operators, scheduling, task dependencies, the Airflow UI and core architecture concepts.

exams.name: Certified Data Management Professional
exams.blurb: DAMA International credential based on the DMBOK covering data governance, quality, modelling, metadata, master data and data architecture.

exams.name: dbt Analytics Engineering Certification
exams.blurb: Certification from dbt Labs covering modelling, testing, documentation, sources, snapshots and deployment of analytics code with dbt.

exams.name: TensorFlow Developer Certificate
exams.blurb: Coding exam on building neural networks with TensorFlow for image, text and time-series tasks; Google retired the programme but it remains widely searched.

exams.name: Oracle Cerner Millennium Certification
exams.blurb: Healthcare IT credential covering Cerner Millennium EHR modules, including PowerChart and registration, for clinical system analysts.

exams.name: Shopify Partner Foundations Certification
exams.blurb: Confirms commerce fundamentals and Shopify platform knowledge for partners building and supporting online storefronts.
